units.source_text: 其实现在已没有慌慌张张逃跑的必要了。

en.t: In fact, there was no longer any need to flee in a panic.

units.source_text: 他手中捏着的往返车票，在“前往目的地”、“返回场所”等地方都是空白，

en.t: The round-trip ticket he held clenched in his hand had blank spaces for things like destination and place of return,
and he could fill them in however he liked.

units.source_text: 而且，再往深里考虑一下，他的心已经给一种欲望填满了：

en.t: And, thinking a little more deeply, his heart was already filled with a certain desire:

units.source_text: 他渴望将囤水装置的事告诉给别人。

en.t: he longed to tell someone about the water-storage device.

units.source_text: 要告诉的话，除了这村里的人，可能没有其他人想听。

en.t: If he was going to tell anyone, perhaps no one except the people in this village would want to listen.

units.source_text: 今天不行，那就明天，男人会向什么人挑明吧。

en.t: If not today, then tomorrow; the man would surely reveal it to someone.
